verdict.rationale: LiteLLM Proxy ships a first-party MCP Gateway. It exposes a fixed endpoint for all MCP tools, with access controlled by key and team [litellm-docs-14]. MCP servers are registered through the admin UI [litellm-docs-27], and REST endpoints let you list and call tools directly [litellm-docs-33], so agents can connect through an official MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: client-side connection details (transport, auth headers, example agent configs) and any independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
